import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.multiclass import OneVsRestClassifier
from sklearn.linear_model import LogisticRegression
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import warnings
import os
import re

warnings.filterwarnings("ignore")
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)


def preprocess_text(text):
    """Enhanced text preprocessing with precise emoji removal and timestamp handling."""
    if not isinstance(text, str):
        text = str(text)

    # Convert to lowercase
    text = text.lower()

    # Remove HTML tags and entities
    text = re.sub(r"<[^>]+>", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\"", "", text)
    text = re.sub(r"&", "", text)
    text = re.sub(r"<", "", text)
    text = re.sub(r">", "", text)

    # Remove URLs and website patterns
    text = re.sub(r"http\S+", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"https\S+", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"www\.\S+", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"ftp\S+", " ", text)

    # Remove username/mention patterns - captures @ followed by word chars, underscores, and periods
    text = re.sub(r"@[\w\.]+", " ", text)

    # Add new: Remove Wikipedia timestamps/date patterns that act as spam noise
    # YYYY-MM-DD, DD/MM/YYYY, MM-DD-YYYY formats commonly found in system messages
    text = re.sub(r"\b\d{4}-\d{2}-\d{2}\b", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b\d{2}/\d{2}/\d{4}\b", " ", text)
    text = re.sub(r"\b\d{2}-\d{2}-\d{4}\b", " ", text)

    # Remove long numeric-only strings that might be IDs
    text = re.sub(r"\b\d{3,}\b", " ", text)

    # Precise emoji removal using EXPLICIT unicode ranges ONLY
    text = re.sub(
        r"[\U0001F300-\U0001F6FF\U0001F6E0-\U0001FFFF\u200c\u200d]+", " ", text
    )

    # Replace multiple spaces with single space
    text = re.sub(r"\s+", " ", text).strip()

    return text


def main():
    print("Loading data...")
    train = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv", encoding="utf-8")
    test = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv", encoding="utf-8")
    sample_sub = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission.csv", encoding="utf-8")

    tox_columns = [
        "toxic",
        "severe_toxic",
        "obscene",
        "threat",
        "insult",
        "identity_hate",
    ]

    X_train_raw = train["comment_text"]
    X_test_raw = test["comment_text"]
    y_train = train[tox_columns].values
    test_ids = test["id"].values

    # Apply enhanced text preprocessing WITH timestamp removal and precise emoji removal
    print("Preprocessing text...")
    train_copy = train[["id", "comment_text"]].copy()
    train_copy["comment_text"] = X_train_raw.apply(preprocess_text)

    # Process test data
    test_df = test.copy()
    test_df["comment_text"] = test_df["comment_text"].apply(preprocess_text)

    X_train = train_copy["comment_text"].astype(str)
    X_test = test_df["comment_text"].astype(str).values
    test_ids_new = test_df["id"].values

    # Vectorize text
    print("Vectorizing text...")
    vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
        max_features=50000,
        min_df=2,
        ngram_range=(1, 2),
        stop_words="english",
        sublinear_tf=False,
        smooth_idf=False,
        binary=True,
    )
    X_train_vec = vectorizer.fit_transform(X_train.tolist())
    X_test_vec = vectorizer.transform(X_test.tolist())

    # Split data WITHOUT stratification for stability
    print("Splitting data...")
    X_trn_val, X_val, y_trn_val, y_val = train_test_split(
        X_train_vec, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, shuffle=False
    )

    if len(y_trn_val) > 0:
        X_train_final = X_trn_val.copy()
        y_train_final = y_trn_val.copy()
    else:
        raise ValueError("No training samples after split!")

    # Train ONEVSREST CLASSIFIER
    print("Training classifier...")
    ovr_clf = OneVsRestClassifier(
        LogisticRegression(
            class_weight="balanced",
            max_iter=2000,
            C=1.0,
            solver="lbfgs",
            warm_start=False,
            verbose=0,
            n_jobs=-1,
        ),
        n_jobs=-1,
    )
    ovr_clf.fit(X_train_final, y_train_final)

    # Generate predictions for validation set
    val_preds = ovr_clf.predict_proba(X_val)

    # Compute validation metric correctly - mean of per-class AUCs
    col_roc_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_preds, average=None)
    mean_val_auc = np.mean(col_roc_auc)

    print(f"\nValidation Mean Column-wise ROC AUC: {mean_val_auc:.6f}")
    print(f"Per-Class Validation AUCs: {[f'{auc:.6f}' for auc in col_roc_auc]}")

    # Generate predictions ONLY on TEST SET
    print("Generating predictions for test set...")
    test_probs = ovr_clf.predict_proba(X_test_vec)

    # Create submission file using sample_submission template columns
    print("Creating submission file...")
    submission = pd.DataFrame(test_probs, columns=tox_columns)
    submission.insert(0, "id", test_ids_new)

    # Save to REQUIRED PATH
    submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
    print("Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")

    # Print final metrics
    print("\n=== FINAL EVALUATION METRIC ===")
    print(f"Mean Column-wise ROC AUC: {mean_val_auc:.6f}")
    print(f"Column ROC AUCs: {[f'{auc:.6f}' for auc in col_roc_auc]}")


if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
